summary: Csquare, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its IPO underwriting agreement and a registration rights agreement. The company sold 50 million shares at $21.00 per share, netting ~$1.01 billion, with an underwriter option for 7.5 million more. This is a standard capital markets transaction — not a special situation. The registration rights agreement with Brookfield is routine. No special-situation event is present.
